title: Learning Multi-Index Models with Hyper-Kernel Ridge Regression
abstract: arXiv:2510.02532v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks excel in high-dimensional problems, outperforming models such as kernel methods, which suffer from the curse of dimensionality. However, the theoretical foundations of this success remain poorly understood. We follow the idea that the compositional structure of the learning task is the key factor determining when deep networks outperform other approaches. Taking a step towards formalizing this idea, we consider a simple compositional model, namely the multi-index model (MIM). In this context, we introduce and study hyper-kernel ridge regression (HKRR), an approach blending neural networks and kernel methods. Our main contribution is a sample complexity result demonstrating that HKRR can adaptively learn MIM, overcoming the curse of dimensionality. translated_title: 基于超核岭回归的多指标模型学习
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络在高维问题中表现出色，优于核方法等因维度灾难而受限的模型。然而，这一成功背后的理论基础仍知之甚少。我们遵循这样一个观点：学习任务的复合结构是决定深度网络何时优于其他方法的关键因素。为了将这一想法形式化，我们考虑了一个简单的复合模型，即多指标模型（MIM）。在此背景下，我们引入并研究了超核岭回归（HKRR），这是一种融合神经网络与核方法的方法。我们的主要贡献是一个样本复杂度结果，证明HKRR能够自适应地学习多指标模型，从而克服维度灾难。此外，我们利用该估计量的核特性开发了专门的优化方法。实际上，我们对比了交替最小化和交替梯度下降（原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出融合神经网络与核方法的超核岭回归（HKRR）方法，并通过样本复杂度理论证明其能够自适应地学习多指标模型，克服维度灾难。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces hyper-kernel ridge regression (HKRR), a method blending neural networks and kernel methods, and proves through a sample complexity result that HKRR can adaptively learn multi-index models, overcoming the curse of dimensionality.
